name: e2_core32
question: Experiment 1 again on a harder instance: 32 circles, where AlphaEvolve (2.93794) stopped short of the best known (2.93957, FICO Xpress 2026). (Cut from 40 to 15 rounds on Nov 5: two setups reached the best known packing within 7 rounds; this problem also has a ceiling within reach.)

notes.floor: the model sees the best program and writes a better one, 6 times a round
notes.population: v4's mutation loop alone: parents sampled by rank, another strong program for ideas
notes.plan+notes: v4's two loops with plain notes of every experiment for the planner
notes.planned-only: the planner with notes, no mutation loop

references: within 1e-9 of the best known (2.939572771205, Packomania)
